title: Amazon Stock Drops 7% Despite 39% AWS Growth!!
creator: Jose Najarro Stocks
summary: Jose Najarro Stocks covers a brutal night for AI stocks: Amazon down ~7.3% after hours, Intel down ~23-24%, plus unconfirmed reports that Nvidia may guarantee billions of NScale debt for a 460MW Anthropic project. On Nvidia he withholds judgment: the reports are unconfirmed, final terms and exposure unknown, and while the market fears neo-cloud credit is drying up, revenue-sharing on lent money plus Anthropic's S1 strength mean he is 'not necessarily bearish'; he wants confirmation before deciding, so no NVDA call is recorded here and his prior BUY stands untouched. NScale itself raised ~$3.3 billion on 25 September ($1 billion from Nvidia), runs 50,000+ GPUs, and claims $103 billion+ of contracted value (not revenue). Intel's guide midpoint of $15.5 billion badly missed ~$17 billion expected, hit by a consumer PC correction on memory prices and an Israel fab incident disrupting 10nm server supply (~$300 million revenue, ~200bp margins), even as data-center revenue rose 78% year over year; he expects AMD to take share Intel cannot supply, with supply constrained into 2027-28. AWS grew 39.3% to $46 billion (~$180 billion ARR) with 40%+ growth guided for 2027 and 2028, margins slipping 0.7 points sequentially to 38.7%, capex ~$220 billion in 2026 and rising in 2027, trailing free cash flow about -$42 billion, and external Trainium sales from late 2027. Calls: AMZN UNCERTAIN (first tracked, no directional statement); INTC UNCERTAIN (reiterated). Caption garbles: Fab 22/Fab 28 used interchangeably for the Israel plant, 'Tranium' for Trainium.
